bridge-type.label: Live Tennis API Account
bridge-type.description: Provides access to the Live Tennis API with one API key. Polls the live match snapshot once per refresh interval and shares it with all player and tournament things of this bridge.

parameter.name: apiKey
parameter.label: API Key
parameter.description: API key for the Live Tennis API. A free key is self-serve at https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often to poll the live match snapshot in seconds. The default of 900 s stays within the free tier's daily quota; lower values need a paid tier.

thing-type.label: Tennis Player
thing-type.description: Tracks one player (or doubles team): their live match state, their next scheduled match and their current ranking. Score channels list the tracked player first.

parameter.name: playerId
parameter.label: Player ID
parameter.description: The player's id in the Live Tennis API. Look it up with GET /players?search=name.

parameter.name: detailRefreshInterval
parameter.label: Detail Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often to refresh the next match and the ranking in seconds. Each cycle costs two API requests per player thing.

thing-type.label: Tennis Tournament
thing-type.description: Tracks one tournament of the catalogue: its metadata, how many of its matches are in progress and the state of the first listed live match.

parameter.name: tournamentId
parameter.label: Tournament ID
parameter.description: The tournament's stable id in the Live Tennis API. Look it up with GET /tournaments?search=name.

channel-group-type.label: API Usage
channel-group-type.description: The API key's own tier and daily usage. Reading it is quota-exempt.

channel-group-type.label: Live Match
channel-group-type.description: The tracked player's match currently in progress. All channels are UNDEF while the player has no live match.

channel-group-type.label: Next Match
channel-group-type.description: The tracked player's next scheduled match.

channel.label: Next Opponent
channel.description: Opponent in the next scheduled match

channel.label: Next Tournament
channel.description: Tournament of the next scheduled match

channel.label: Next Round
channel.description: Round of the next scheduled match

channel-group-type.label: Tournament Info
channel-group-type.description: Curated tournament metadata; individual values can be UNDEF where the catalogue has no curated entry.

channel-group-type.label: Live Matches
channel-group-type.description: The tournament's matches currently in progress. Match channels show the first listed live match.

channel-type.label: Tier
channel-type.description: Access tier of the API key (free, basic, pro or ultra)

channel-type.label: Calls Today
channel-type.description: API calls made today with this key

channel-type.label: Remaining Today
channel-type.description: API calls remaining today within the daily quota

channel-type.label: Match Status
channel-type.description: Lifecycle status of the match

channel-type.label: Tournament
channel-type.description: Name of the tournament

channel-type.label: Round
channel-type.description: Round of the match as stated by the feed

channel-type.label: Opponent
channel-type.description: Name of the opponent

channel-type.label: Score Line
channel-type.description: Games per set, e.g. "6-4 3-2"

channel-type.label: Sets
channel-type.description: Sets won, e.g. "1-0"

channel-type.label: Points
channel-type.description: In-game points, e.g. "40-15" or "AD-40"

channel-type.label: Serving
channel-type.description: ON while the tracked player is serving; UNDEF when no game is in progress

channel-type.label: Break Point
channel-type.description: ON while the current game stands at break point; never ON in a tiebreak; UNDEF when the score state does not allow deriving it

channel-type.label: Tiebreak
channel-type.description: ON while a tiebreak is being played

channel-type.label: Start Time
channel-type.description: Scheduled start of the next match; UNDEF until the order of play assigns a time

channel-type.label: Ranking
channel-type.description: The player's current singles or doubles ranking

channel-type.label: Ranking Points
channel-type.description: The player's current ranking points

channel-type.label: Surface
channel-type.description: Court surface of the tournament

channel-type.label: Category
channel-type.description: Tournament category where the catalogue states it unambiguously, e.g. grand_slam or atp_250

channel-type.label: Live Match Count
channel-type.description: Number of this tournament's matches currently in progress

channel-type.label: Players
channel-type.description: Both participants of the featured live match, e.g. "Player One vs Player Two"

channel-type.label: Server
channel-type.description: Name of the player serving in the featured live match
